name: FREN 1169
title: Modernity in Crisis: France and the Francophone World From 1850 to Today
description: A cultural history of France and its colonial empire through political, social, artistic and literary revolutions and scandals. Topics include: Impressionism and the shock of the new, the Eiffel Tower scandal, Nazi occupation and the resistance, U.S. cultural imperialism, feminism, immigration and the crisis of national identity. Taught in English. CA 1. CA 4-INT.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
